fluff.overview: The LCAF fields conventional infantry that benefit from the Commonwealth's deep industrial base, equipping even garrison formations with reliable, well-maintained weapons and transport. Foot infantry platoons form the backbone of the LCAF's garrison forces, deploying on foot to hold positions, patrol perimeters, and secure urban areas where vehicles cannot easily operate. Equipped with Maxell PL-10 laser rifles and semi-portable support lasers, these platoons field an all-energy weapons loadout that eliminates ammunition dependency at the cost of increased power pack requirements. These Xenoplanetary Condition Troops carry specialized survival gear that allows them to fight in extreme temperatures, toxic atmospheres, or unusual gravity conditions where standard infantry cannot operate.
